name: iconsect
description: Iconsect: the Claude Code plugin that renders and embeds a consistent set of Grasshopper component icons from icons.json.

plugins.name: iconsect
plugins.description: Layered icon generation for Grasshopper plugins. Pick a background style from a rendered preview, then render every icon (shape + optional watermark + Iconify glyph) from icons.json and embed them into Resources.resx.
